senses.gloss:
Kirmīravadha : m.: Name of the 30th parvan of the Bhārata in the list of a hundred sub-parvans supposed to have been made by Vyāsa in the Parvasaṁgraha 1. 2. 42, 33, 70.

Referred to in the listing of the contents of the Āraṇyakaparvan 1. 2. 106; related to the incidents narrated in the Adhyāya 3. 12.
